# The test vectors of RFC 8439 (ChaCha20 and Poly1305 for IETF Protocols, June 2018), transcribed by hand from the RFC's
# text: sections 2.3.2, 2.4.2, 2.5.2, 2.6.2 and 2.8.2, and Appendix A.1 to A.5. Read by tests/test_crypto.cpp.
# Format: "vector <kind> <name>" opens a vector and "end" closes it. Inside, a line holding only a field name starts that
# field and the hex lines after it (two digits per byte, separated by spaces) are its bytes; "counter <n>" is the decimal
# initial block counter. Lines starting with # are comments.
# Kinds and their fields:
# - block: key, nonce, counter, keystream (the serialized block: the keystream of 64 bytes at that counter).
# - encrypt: key, nonce, counter, plain, cipher (ChaCha20 from that initial counter).
# - poly1305: key (r then s, 32 bytes), message, tag.
# - polykey: key, nonce, polykey (the first 32 bytes of the block at counter 0).
# - aead: key, nonce, aad, plain, cipher, tag (AEAD_CHACHA20_POLY1305). In 2.8.2 the nonce is the 32-bit fixed-common
#   part 07 00 00 00 followed by the IV 40 41 42 43 44 45 46 47.
